sourceActivities: First Edition summary: sodium-22 half-life, table and function

tasks.required: Root-of-2 six-hour doubling and fourth-root one-half four-hour decay
Distinguish 3 pg data table from 2.5 pg fossil starting 20,000 BCE
tasks.teacherRubric: Explain A0=2.5 pg, 1/2 per half-life, H=5730 years and date origin

autoCheck: remaining at age around 2575 years approximately .732
85 percent corresponds to about 1343.5 model years
tasks.teacherRubric: Distinguish evidence conflicting with claim from conclusive proof of fake

tasks.required: 1450 Bible paper estimated remaining fraction in 2026
tasks.teacherRubric: Justify use of elapsed years and approximations

tasks.required: Interpret exponential function f(t)=4*(1/2)^(t/3) with three-year half-life and different nanogram units
tasks.teacherRubric: Interpret input t as elapsed years, output f(t) as nanograms, four as initial mass and three as three-year half-life; do not mix the carbon-14 isotope or picogram units.

negativeCases: Using 3 pg rather than 2.5 pg for 20,000 BCE fossil
Interpreting 20,000 BCE as elapsed 20,000 years in 2026
Using 85 instead of .85 as remaining proportion
Autoscoring narrative fraud verdict as definite
Treating sodium-22 three-year half-life as carbon-14's 5,730-year half-life or confusing nanograms with picograms
Reporting sodium-22 as fully vanished after 24 years, negative elapsed years or nonfinite answers
